title: More, less, same

parent.learn: Compare two groups by pairing them up.
parent.why: Match each thing in one group with one in the other. The group with things left over has more — you don't even need to count.

parent.learn: Use the words more, fewer (less) and same.
parent.why: These words come before signs like > and <; the child needs the idea first and the symbol later.
Numbers come in counting order. A number said later in counting is always more than one said earlier.

parent.learn: For two-digit numbers, look at the tens first.
parent.why: One ten is more than any pile of up to 9 loose ones, so 45 is less than 54: four tens is less than five tens.

ask: Give two plates of biscuits: which plate has more? How do you know?
Are there more spoons or more forks in the drawer?
Who has more fingers up: you (3) or me (5)?
Make your pile the same as mine.
Are there fewer people or fewer chairs at the dinner table?

rounds.h: Pair them up: two apples on the left have no partner, so the left has more.
One fish is less than three fish.

rounds.t: Are these the same number? 🌸🌸🌸 and 🌼🌼🌼
rounds.h: Pair each pink flower with a yellow one — none are left over, so they are the same: 3 and 3.

rounds.t: Which are more: dogs or cats?
rounds.h: 5 dogs and 3 cats: 5 is more than 3.
Count each plate: 5, 3, 1, 2. Five is the most.
When counting, 7 comes after 4, so 7 is bigger.
6 comes before 9 when counting, so it is smaller.

rounds.t: Ravi has 5 sweets. Meena has 8 sweets. Who has more?
rounds.h: 8 is more than 5, so Meena has more.
10 comes last when we count, so it is the biggest.

rounds.t: Who has fewer chicks: Asha or Ben?
rounds.h: Asha has 6, Ben has 4. 4 is fewer than 6.
Look at the tens: 54 has 5 tens, 45 has only 4 tens. So 54 is bigger.
38 has 3 tens, 83 has 8 tens. Fewer tens means smaller.
91 and 90 both have 9 tens. Then the ones: 1 is more than 0, so 91.

rounds.t: Mohan has 12 marbles and Sita has 12 marbles. Who has more?
rounds.h: 12 and 12 are equal — the same number.
17 has just 1 ten. All the others have more tens.
